v2.4.0 Update
- GM clients now default to the GM Master Phone when no valid phone is selected.
- Added public APIs for opening the widget, listing installed apps, and opening an installed app.
- Direct app launches now recheck phone access and app installation after the lock screen, and delayed renders no longer replace the requested app.
- Players without an assigned phone now see the no-device screen without leftover phone visuals.
- Requires GlitchSmith Library v0.13.0 or later.

announcement.title: 📱 Smartphone Widget v2.4.0
announcement.content:
Smartphone Widget v2.4.0 improves GM phone selection and app opening reliability.

  • GM clients now default to the GM Master Phone when no valid phone is selected.
  • New public APIs let integrations open the widget, inspect installed apps, and open an installed app.
  • Direct app launches recheck phone access and app installation after the lock screen, and delayed renders no longer replace the requested app.
  • Players without an assigned phone now see the no-device screen without leftover wallpaper, frame, or app content.
  • This update requires GlitchSmith Library v0.13.0 or later.
